subject_line: Pre-service appeal - Dorothy Kessler - Auth ref SHP-PA-118734 - Right TKA (27447-RT)
key_arguments: The denial was based only on missing PT documentation; the enclosed Northgate PT discharge summary documents 14 visits over about 12 weeks with no functional improvement.
The patient failed four conservative modalities within 12 months: PT with HEP, NSAIDs, two corticosteroid injections, and activity modification with a cane plus weight counseling.
Weight-bearing X-rays show KL grade 4 bone-on-bone medial osteoarthritis (Criterion 1).
Severe functional limitation is documented with KOOS JR 44.8 and walking tolerance under 1 block (Criterion 2).
BMI 31.4, HbA1c 6.4%, no infection, and documented shared decision-making satisfy Criteria 4-6.
